name: Spare Market
replaces: eBay, Etsy, Facebook Marketplace, Shopify and local sites such as Trade Me
summary: A place where members buy and sell anything, from a used couch to a maker's whole online shop and its shop counter. Listing is free, selling costs only the at-cost fee, and the buyer's money is held until the item arrives.

areas.name: Accounts and seller set-up
areas.summary: Joining with one Spareware login, a public trading profile, the checks a seller needs before selling, business accounts with staff, and leaving cleanly.

features.name: Sign up and sign in
features.does: Join with one Spareware login, using a passkey or a password, and start browsing or selling straight away.

parts.name: Market sign-up flow
parts.what: The Market's steps on the kit's sign-up flow: pick a region and accept the Market's plain-language terms.

parts.name: Market member record
parts.what: The Market's own settings for a member: region, buying and selling status, preferences and limits.

parts.name: Second step for sellers
parts.what: Requires the kit's second sign-in step before a member can receive payouts or run a shop, because trading accounts are a target for takeover.

parts.name: Market age rules
parts.what: The minimum age to buy and to sell on the Market, and which items only adults may buy or sell, set on the kit's minimum age and its rules for young people.

features.name: Trading profile
features.does: Show a public profile with a name, area, photo, join date, ratings, listings and how quickly they reply.

parts.name: Profile page
parts.what: The public page for a member: name, suburb or town, photo, join date, badges, ratings and current listings.

parts.name: Profile privacy settings
parts.what: Choose what others see, such as town only and never the street address, and whether past sales are shown.

features.name: Verify who you are
features.does: Earn verified badges by confirming a phone number, an address and identity through a regulated check.

parts.name: Contact checks before trading
parts.what: Requires a phone number and email confirmed with the kit's checks before a member's first sale or purchase.

parts.name: When the Market asks for an identity check
parts.what: Sends members to the kit's identity check before payouts above a set amount, before selling vehicles or high-value items, and for the verified badge.

parts.name: Address check
parts.what: Confirms an address by a code sent by post or a trusted record, so buyers know a seller is real; hosts, home sellers and landlords need the same check, so it should move down into the kit as an identity check.

parts.name: Where badges show
parts.what: Shows the kit's verified badges on Market profiles, listings, offers and chat headers.

features.name: Say you sell in trade
features.does: Declare that you sell as a business, so buyers see it on every listing and the right consumer law applies.

parts.name: In-trade declaration
parts.what: Requires in-trade sellers to say so, and shows the kit's trader details on every listing, as consumer law requires (example: New Zealand's Fair Trading Act).

parts.name: In-trade prompts
parts.what: Spot members who sell like a business, such as many new identical items, and ask them to declare.

features.name: Set up payouts
features.does: Connect a bank account for payouts through the payment provider's own sign-up, without the Market seeing card or bank secrets.

parts.name: Payout set-up from the Market
parts.what: Starts the kit's payout set-up at a seller's first sale, so they can list before it is done but cannot be paid until it is.

parts.name: Market seller checks
parts.what: Which Market sellers the kit's customer checks cover and when, such as before high payouts or many high-value sales, under the co-op's one anti-money-laundering programme.

features.name: Business accounts and staff
features.does: Add staff to a business account with their own logins and only the Market permissions they need.

parts.name: Market business roles
parts.what: The Market's roles on the kit's organisation model: owner, manager, packer and till operator, and what each may do with listings, orders and money.

parts.name: Staff action log
parts.what: Every staff action recorded as an operation, so the owner can see who changed what.

features.name: Block a member or set buyer rules
features.does: Block a member, or set rules on who may buy, so unwanted buyers cannot buy, make offers, bid or message you.

parts.name: Block enforcement
parts.what: Checks the kit's block list and the seller's buyer rules at offer, bid, purchase and message time.

parts.name: Buyer rules
parts.what: Seller-set rules on who may buy: verified buyers only, buyers in areas the seller ships to, buyers with no unpaid or no-show record, and a limit on items per buyer.

features.name: Pause or close an account
features.does: Pause selling for a holiday, or close the account once orders, held money, disputes and anything owed to customers are settled.

parts.name: Holiday mode
parts.what: Hide listings or mark them as away, with an away message and a return date.

parts.name: Account closure flow
parts.what: Before closing, checks open orders, held money, disputes and anything a shop still owes customers (gift card balances, store credit, pre-orders, subscriptions and layby), and offers a full data export first.

parts.name: Estate handover
parts.what: The Market's steps on the kit's after-death handling: listings ended, open orders finished and held money paid to the estate.

areas.name: Listing items
areas.summary: Putting an item up for sale in a few minutes from a phone, with good photos, an honest description, the right price type, and help from the Market to get it right.

features.name: Create a listing
features.does: List an item with a title, photos, description, condition, price and pickup or shipping in a few minutes.

parts.name: Listing record
parts.what: The Market's listing on top of the kit's marketplace listing: item details, price type, quantity, location, shipping and state.

parts.name: Listing commands
parts.what: Create, edit, end, relist and mark sold as operations, so people, AI agents and add-ins all use one path.

parts.name: Listing form
parts.what: A short step-by-step form for phones and computers that asks only what the chosen category needs.

parts.name: Listing page
parts.what: What buyers see: photos, price, condition, details, seller, shipping and pickup, questions and the full price before buying.

parts.name: Listing pages found by web search
parts.what: Every listing page rendered on the server, with product data markup, site maps and a share card, so web search and shared links bring buyers in; shop sites reuse the same pages.

features.name: Add photos and video
features.does: Take photos straight from the phone camera, crop and reorder them, and add a short video.

parts.name: Market photo rules
parts.what: The Market's photo count, sizes and crops on the kit's file uploads, which resume on a bad connection, strip location data and run the safety scans.

parts.name: Photo editor
parts.what: Crop, rotate, straighten, brighten and reorder photos before posting.

parts.name: Short video
parts.what: A clip of up to a minute per listing, compressed for phones.

parts.name: Photo limits and clean-up
parts.what: A per-listing photo limit, and clean-up a set time after a listing ends, on the kit's storage at cost.

features.name: Choose how to price
features.does: Sell at a fixed price, accept offers above a minimum, give it away free, or ask for a swap.

parts.name: Price types
parts.what: Fixed price, fixed price with offers, free and swap, with room for auctions later.

parts.name: Auto-accept and auto-decline
parts.what: Seller-set limits that accept offers above one amount and decline offers below another.

features.name: Edit, end, relist and expire
features.does: Change a listing, end it early, mark it sold elsewhere, and relist it when it expires.

parts.name: Listing lifecycle rules
parts.what: How long a listing runs, renewals, and what may change once there are offers, questions or bids.

parts.name: Change history for buyers
parts.what: Material changes made after a buyer has engaged are shown on the listing.

parts.name: On hold for a buyer
parts.what: Mark an item as on hold for a named buyer for a set time, so others see it is spoken for.

features.name: Check a listing before it goes live
features.does: Get told before posting if an item is banned, restricted, or needs extra details by law.

parts.name: Market listing checks
parts.what: Runs the Market's item rules and category fields through the kit's listing checks, and explains any problem in plain words.

parts.name: Product safety fields
parts.what: Extra fields the law asks for on some items, such as safety warnings, or the maker's details for buyers in the EU.

features.name: Help me write it
features.does: Get a suggested title, category and details from the photos, and a price guide from similar sold items.

parts.name: Suggestions from photos
parts.what: Suggests category, title and details from the photos and words; the seller confirms every field and nothing posts without them.

parts.name: Price guide
parts.what: A range of what similar items sold for recently, shown while pricing.

parts.name: AI help labels
parts.what: How AI-made or AI-edited listing photos are labelled, and what the seller must confirm, under the kit's AI tools policy.

features.name: Sell several of one item, or in options
features.does: List one item in several sizes or colours, or many of the same, with stock counted down as each sells.

parts.name: Variants and quantity
parts.what: Options such as size and colour, each with its own price, stock and photos.

parts.name: Option picker
parts.what: Lets buyers choose an option and see its price and stock.

features.name: Drafts, templates and scheduling
features.does: Save a draft, start from an old listing or a template, and choose when a listing starts.

parts.name: Drafts that work offline
parts.what: Drafts saved on the device and synced, so a listing can be started with no signal.

parts.name: Templates and sell similar
parts.what: Start a new listing from a saved template or a past listing.

parts.name: Scheduled start
parts.what: Pick a date and time for a listing to go live.

features.name: Say how it was made
features.does: Mark an item as handmade, designed by the seller, vintage, made with a production partner, or made with AI, so buyers know.

parts.name: Making declaration
parts.what: Our own set of making labels on each listing, with the partner named where one was used.

parts.name: Making checks
parts.what: Spot checks and member reports for false handmade or vintage claims.

features.name: Made to order, personalised and digital items
features.does: Sell items made after the order, ask the buyer for personal details such as a name to engrave, or sell a digital download.

parts.name: Personalisation fields
parts.what: Seller-set questions the buyer answers at checkout, with length limits.

parts.name: Making time
parts.what: Days needed to make an item before dispatch, shown and used in delivery estimates; when making takes longer than a card hold lasts, the buyer pays a deposit then the balance.

parts.name: Digital file delivery
parts.what: Secure download links after payment, with a download limit and the file kept safe from sharing links.

parts.name: Digital goods rules
parts.what: Sales tax on digital items, refunds for downloads, and the seller confirming they hold the rights.

features.name: Post a wanted ad
features.does: Say what you are looking for and let sellers who have it reply.

parts.name: Wanted ad record
parts.what: An ask on the kit's marketplace loop: what is wanted, a price range, area and an end date.

parts.name: Wanted ad alerts
parts.what: Shows a wanted ad to sellers listing similar items, and tells the asker about matching new listings through the saved search matcher (MKT-A4-F4-P2).

parts.name: Wanted ads search
parts.what: Wanted ads in their own search tab, with replies going to the chat.

features.name: Share a listing
features.does: Share any listing by link with a photo card, to a community group, a chat or any social site.

parts.name: Share cards
parts.what: A share link and photo card for every listing, ready for community groups, chats and social sites, including through open social protocols.

features.name: Swap or trade
features.does: Offer an item for a swap, or a swap plus money, and agree the trade in the chat.

parts.name: Swap offers
parts.what: Swap offers on the kit's offers: an item for an item, or an item plus money, with buyer protection only on the money part.

parts.name: Swap handover
parts.what: Both sides confirm the swap with their own pickup codes, and both rate the trade.

features.name: Hire out an item
features.does: Hire out tools, cameras, party gear and other items for a day or a week, with a deposit held until they come back.

parts.name: Hire listings
parts.what: A hire price per day or week, an availability calendar and a return date, on the kit's availability calendars.

parts.name: Hire deposits and damage
parts.what: A deposit held with the kit's deposits and damage holds, a return check with photos, and a damage claim that goes to a dispute if the two sides disagree.

parts.name: Hire terms
parts.what: A plain hire agreement, and the consumer law that applies when an owner hires out items in trade.

areas.name: Categories and item details
areas.summary: A shared category tree and the item details each kind of item needs, so filters work, listings can be compared, and known products fill themselves in.

features.name: Browse categories
features.does: Find items by walking a category tree, in their own language.

parts.name: Category tree
parts.what: Our own versioned category tree with translations, built from open product classifications where their licences allow.

parts.name: Open classification sources
parts.what: Which open product classifications we may build on, under which licences, and how to credit them.

parts.name: Category browse pages
parts.what: Category pages with sub-categories, counts and the most useful filters for each.

parts.name: Category change proposals
parts.what: Members propose new or merged categories; moderators apply them and listings move with them.

features.name: Item details by category
features.does: Fill in the details that matter for each kind of item, such as size, brand, capacity or year.

parts.name: Item fields per category
parts.what: A schema of required and optional fields for each category, with allowed values.

parts.name: Units and sizes
parts.what: Metric first, with clothing and shoe size charts and conversions for other countries.

features.name: Describe the condition
features.does: Choose a clear condition grade with a short definition, and point out flaws with photos.

parts.name: Condition scale
parts.what: Our own condition grades per kind of item, each with a plain definition.

parts.name: Flaw notes
parts.what: A place to list flaws and link each to a photo.

features.name: Scan a barcode or book number
features.does: Scan a barcode or ISBN to fill in the details of a known product.

parts.name: Barcode scanner
parts.what: Reads barcodes and ISBNs with the phone camera, in the browser.

parts.name: Product catalogue
parts.what: Shared records of known products, built by members and from open product data whose licences allow it.

parts.name: Open product data sources
parts.what: Which open product and book databases exist, their licences and what they cover in each launch country, starting with New Zealand.

features.name: Parts that fit
features.does: Check whether a vehicle, appliance or device part fits your model before buying.

parts.name: Fit data
parts.what: Records of which part fits which model, from open or properly licensed data and seller input.

parts.name: Fit data licences
parts.what: Where vehicle and appliance fit data can be obtained, at what cost and under what terms.

parts.name: My vehicle filter
parts.what: Save a vehicle or model and filter search to parts that fit it.

features.name: Proof for valuable items
features.does: Add serial numbers, certificates and proof of origin for collectables and valuable items.

parts.name: Proof of origin fields
parts.what: Serial numbers, certificates and history attached to a listing and carried to the buyer.

parts.name: Independent checkers
parts.what: Independent authenticators for high-value items such as watches and trading cards: how they check, what it costs, and how the item travels.

parts.name: Stolen goods check
parts.what: Check serial numbers against public stolen-property lists where they exist.

areas.name: Search and discovery
areas.summary: Finding the right item fast: keyword search, filters, distance, fair ranking with published rules and no paid placement, saved searches, watchlists and feeds people choose.

features.name: Search by keyword
features.does: Search all listings by words, with spelling forgiven and results in under a second.

parts.name: Market search fields
parts.what: Puts every live listing, its item fields, price, location and seller into the kit's search service within seconds of a change, with the Market's filters and sorting.

parts.name: Market words and synonyms
parts.what: Market synonyms and word stems for item names and brands, on the kit's macron-aware matching.

parts.name: Search page
parts.what: Search box, results, filters and sorting that work on a phone and with a screen reader.

features.name: Filter and sort
features.does: Narrow results by category, price, condition, distance, shipping, seller type and item details.

parts.name: Filters from item fields
parts.what: Filters built from each category's fields, with counts per value.

parts.name: Distance search
parts.what: Search by distance from a town or suburb, without revealing anyone's exact address.

features.name: Fair ranking, published
features.does: See how results are ordered, knowing no one can pay to push other sellers down.

parts.name: Market ranking factors
parts.what: The Market's factors (relevance, newness, distance and seller reliability) on the kit's published ranking rules, with no paid placement.

parts.name: Why this result
parts.what: Shows the kit's match explanation on each Market result.

parts.name: Ranking changes by vote
parts.what: Changes to the ranking formula go to a member vote and are logged.

features.name: Saved searches and alerts
features.does: Save a search and get told when a new matching item is listed or a price drops.

parts.name: New listing matcher
parts.what: Checks each new or cheaper listing against members' saved searches, including wanted ads, and sends alerts through the kit's notifications.

parts.name: Alert settings
parts.what: Choose instant, daily or weekly alerts, and by push, email or none.

features.name: Watchlist and favourites
features.does: Watch an item to follow its price and end time, and follow favourite sellers and shops.

parts.name: Watchlist
parts.what: Items a member is watching, with notes, on the kit's favourites.

parts.name: Watch alerts
parts.what: Alerts when a watched item is ending, drops in price, gets an offer to watchers, or sells.

parts.name: Lists to share
parts.what: Group saved items into named lists and share a list by link.

features.name: Browse and feeds you choose
features.does: Browse new items nearby or in followed categories and sellers, with the feed's rules shown.

parts.name: Home feed
parts.what: Newest first by default, with feeds members choose, such as near me or followed shops, and the rules of each shown.

parts.name: Follow sellers, shops and categories
parts.what: Follow lists that feed the home page and alerts.

parts.name: Recently viewed and similar items
parts.what: A history of viewed items, and similar items on each listing page.

features.name: Search by photo
features.does: Take a photo of something and find similar items for sale.

parts.name: Image similarity index
parts.what: Finds listings that look like a photo, using an open image model.

parts.name: Open image model choice
parts.what: Open image models compared on licence, accuracy and running cost.

features.name: Map view
features.does: See items for pickup on a map of the area.

parts.name: Listings map
parts.what: Approximate pickup areas on an open map, never exact addresses.

features.name: Search from other apps and AI agents
features.does: Let an AI assistant, price comparer or another app search listings through the open command API.

parts.name: Search commands
parts.what: Search and read commands with rate limits, offered to AI agents through the kit's MCP server.

parts.name: Open listing feed
parts.what: A standard product feed of a seller's listings that web search and comparison sites can read.

features.name: One Market across member-run servers
features.does: Search and trade across every server that runs the Market, including ones members run themselves.

parts.name: Search across servers
parts.what: How listings on member-run servers join one search, so the Market keeps its network when it is split across servers.

parts.name: Trust across servers
parts.what: How held payments, ratings and bans carry across servers, so a scammer banned on one cannot trade on another.

features.name: Search in your own language
features.does: Find listings written in another language, and search in your own.

parts.name: Search across languages
parts.what: Finds listings written in another language, such as Samoan, Mandarin or Hindi, by matching translated words through the kit's translation service, and shows the original with a translation.

areas.name: Buying, offers and checkout
areas.summary: Getting from wanting an item to having paid for it: buy now, offers and counter offers, one cart across sellers, payment choices, cash on pickup, gifts, causes and business buying.

features.name: Buy now
features.does: Buy a fixed-price item in a few taps, with the full price shown before paying.

parts.name: Buy command
parts.what: Reserves the item or stock while paying and stops two people buying the last one.

parts.name: Market price lines
parts.what: The Market's price lines (item, shipping, buyer fee and sales tax) on the kit's full-price-first calculator, shown before the pay button and never added later.

parts.name: Checkout screens
parts.what: Delivery or pickup choice, address, payment and a final check, short enough for a phone.

parts.name: Order confirmation
parts.what: A confirmation page and message to both sides with what happens next.

parts.name: Address book
parts.what: Saved delivery addresses with a default, and gift addresses kept apart so they are never used by mistake.

features.name: Make an offer
features.does: Offer a lower price, and go back and forth with counter offers until one side accepts or it runs out.

parts.name: Market offer rules
parts.what: The Market's rules on the kit's offers: expiry times, how many counters, and payment taken when an offer is accepted.

parts.name: Offer screens
parts.what: Make, accept, decline and counter offers from the listing or the chat.

parts.name: Seller offers to watchers
parts.what: A seller sends one lower price to everyone watching an item, for a limited time.

features.name: Pay the way you want
features.does: Pay by card, bank payment or phone wallet, with saved methods kept by the payment provider.

parts.name: Market payment methods
parts.what: Turns on card, phone wallet and bank payment for the Market through the kit's checkout and saved methods; the Market never sees card numbers.

parts.name: Bank payments in the Market
parts.what: Turns on the kit's bank payments for Market orders, starting with high-value items where card costs are highest.

parts.name: Pay later options
parts.what: Whether buy now pay later fits co-op values, and the lending law that would apply.

features.name: Cash on pickup
features.does: Agree to pay cash at pickup, knowing buyer protection does not cover it.

parts.name: Cash on pickup choice
parts.what: A seller setting and a clear warning to the buyer that protection does not apply.

features.name: One cart across sellers
features.does: Put items from several sellers in one cart and pay once.

parts.name: Cart
parts.what: A cart that holds items from many sellers and many shops, kept across devices.

parts.name: Split payment by seller
parts.what: One payment split into a held amount per seller, each with its own fee.

parts.name: Combined shipping
parts.what: One shipping price when several items come from the same seller.

features.name: Ask for something custom
features.does: Ask a maker for a custom item, agree the price and time in the chat, and buy it from a listing made just for you.

parts.name: Custom request
parts.what: A buyer describes what they want, with photos, and the seller answers with a price and making time.

parts.name: Private listing for one buyer
parts.what: A listing only the named buyer can see and buy, made from the agreed request.

features.name: Buy as a gift
features.does: Send an item as a gift with a note, gift wrap if the seller offers it, and a receipt without prices.

parts.name: Gift options
parts.what: Gift note, wrap choice and a separate delivery address on the order.

parts.name: Gift receipt
parts.what: A receipt without prices that still allows a return.

features.name: Buy for a business
features.does: Get a tax invoice with sales tax details when buying from a seller registered for it.

parts.name: Market tax invoices
parts.what: Tax invoices from the kit for each sale by a seller registered for sales tax, and for the buyer fee to registered buyers.

features.name: Give to a cause
features.does: Sell for a registered charity and send part or all of the price to it, or add a donation at checkout.

parts.name: Donation split
parts.what: Sends the chosen share of a sale to the charity through the payment provider.

parts.name: Donation tax credits
parts.what: A purchase whose proceeds go to a charity is not a gift and earns no donation tax credit; only a separate donation at checkout might, with the charity issuing the receipt.

features.name: Pre-order and back in stock
features.does: Order something not yet made or in stock, or ask to be told when it is back.

parts.name: Pre-order terms
parts.what: Expected dispatch date, the right to cancel if it is late, and when payment is taken: within the provider's hold time limits, or as a deposit then the balance for long waits.

parts.name: Back in stock alerts
parts.what: Tells waiting buyers when stock returns.

features.name: A fair chance at limited stock
features.does: Have a fair chance at limited releases and scarce items, without resellers' bots buying them first.

parts.name: Limits and fair queues
parts.what: Per-person limits and a fair queue for limited releases, with published rules on when agents and scripts may buy or bid, on the kit's automated acceptance rules.

areas.name: Auctions
areas.summary: Timed auctions with reserves, automatic bidding, fair endings and checks against fake bids, built only after the consumer law research says how.

features.name: Run an auction
features.does: Set a starting price, a reserve and an end time, and let buyers bid.

parts.name: Auction law
parts.what: What consumer law, auction rules and in-trade disclosure mean for online auctions run by the Market.

parts.name: Auction engine
parts.what: Bids as operations, ordered by the server so every bidder sees the same truth.

parts.name: Auction settings
parts.what: Start price, reserve, buy now price, length and end time on the listing form.

features.name: Bid and auto-bid
features.does: Bid now, or set a top amount and let the Market bid for you only as much as needed.

parts.name: Automatic bidding
parts.what: Bids for a member up to their hidden top amount, one step at a time.

parts.name: Live bid updates
parts.what: Pushes new bids and the current price to everyone watching within a second.

parts.name: Bid screens
parts.what: Place a bid, set a top amount, and see whether you are winning.

features.name: Fair endings
features.does: Have the end time extend when a bid comes in at the last moment, so last-second bids do not decide it.

parts.name: Auto-extend rule
parts.what: Adds time when a bid arrives in the last minutes, up to a limit, published in the rules.

parts.name: Server clock
parts.what: One clock on the server decides when bids arrive and when auctions close.

features.name: Reserve and buy now
features.does: Hide a reserve price, show when it is met, and offer a buy now price until bidding passes it.

parts.name: Reserve and buy now logic
parts.what: Reserve met flags, buy now removal rules and seller limits on lowering a reserve.

features.name: Bid history and fake bid checks
features.does: See every bid with bidder names hidden, and trust that fake bids from the seller's friends are caught.

parts.name: Public bid history
parts.what: Every bid with amount and time, bidders shown by a short code.

parts.name: Fake bid detection
parts.what: Flags bids from accounts linked to the seller, by device, payment or address signals.

parts.name: Bid withdrawal rules
parts.what: When a bid may be withdrawn, under the auction rules and consumer law.

features.name: When the winner does not pay
features.does: Offer the item to the next highest bidder if the winner backs out.

parts.name: Next bidder offers
parts.what: Offers the item to the runner-up at their highest bid.

parts.name: Unpaid item record
parts.what: Records unpaid wins, which count in seller standards and limits.

features.name: When the reserve is not met
features.does: Offer the item to the top bidder when the reserve is not met, or relist it automatically.

parts.name: Offer after the reserve is not met
parts.what: Lets the seller offer the item at a set price to the highest bidder, then to other bidders and watchers, for a limited time.

parts.name: Automatic relist
parts.what: Relists an unsold item with the same or changed settings, up to a set number of times.

areas.name: Payments, held money and fees
areas.summary: The buyer's money held by a regulated provider until the item arrives, who the seller of record is, the fee and who pays it, payouts, refunds, card disputes, receipts and the Market's anti-money-laundering risks, all on the kit's payments.

features.name: Money held until it arrives
features.does: Pay into a held account; the seller is paid when the buyer confirms, or when the waiting time runs out.

parts.name: Market hold and release rules
parts.what: When a Market order's money is held, released or refunded: on the buyer's confirmation, after the release time, on a pickup code or on a panel decision, using the kit's hold and release rules.

parts.name: Release times
parts.what: The Market's release times on the kit's auto-confirm: a set number of days after tracked delivery or dispatch, paused by any problem report.

parts.name: Pickup code that works offline
parts.what: The buyer's signed pickup code, on the kit's proof of handover, checked on the seller's phone with no signal and synced later to release the money.

features.name: See the fee
features.does: See the exact fee before listing and before paying, who pays it, and what it pays for.

parts.name: Market fee lines
parts.what: The Market's buyer and seller fee lines on the kit's fee calculator, following the fee model (MKT-A7-F2-P4).

parts.name: Fee rules by vote
parts.what: Fee rate changes come from member votes and take effect on a published date.

parts.name: Market fee model
parts.what: Decides who pays (buyer, seller or both), a flat fee per order or one based on value, how percentage card costs, the protection pool and fraud losses are shared, and the fee on free items, $2 items and $30,000 vehicles, since one flat fee breaks at both ends of the price range.

features.name: Get paid
features.does: Get paid to a bank account on a set schedule, with every deduction listed.

parts.name: Market payout timing
parts.what: Pays a seller through the kit's payout runs once each order's money is released, with held and available amounts shown apart on the kit's earnings page.

features.name: Refunds
features.does: Give a full or part refund in a few taps, back to the original payment method.

parts.name: Market refund reasons
parts.what: Full and part refunds on the kit's refunds, each linked to the order and a Market reason.

parts.name: Refund screens
parts.what: Refund from the order with the amount, reason and a note to the buyer.

features.name: Receipts and records
features.does: Get a receipt for every payment and a yearly statement of sales and fees.

parts.name: What a Market receipt shows
parts.what: The seller of record, sales tax and the fee on every receipt from the kit, for online and counter sales alike, printed or emailed.

features.name: Anti-money-laundering duties met
features.does: Trade knowing the Market meets anti-money-laundering law without making honest trade harder.

parts.name: Market risks for the co-op's programme
parts.what: The Market risks the co-op's one anti-money-laundering programme must cover, such as high-value goods, gift cards, stored balances and fake sales used to move money, and which duties the payment provider carries.

parts.name: Market signals for suspicious activity
parts.what: Market patterns, such as repeat sales between the same accounts or prices far above value, sent to the kit's suspicious activity reports.

features.name: Card disputes
features.does: Have card disputes answered on time with evidence from the order, and know who carries a lost one.

parts.name: Market evidence for card disputes
parts.what: Sends tracking, messages, photos and the pickup record to the kit's card disputes within the card network's deadlines.

parts.name: Market loss rule
parts.what: Who carries a lost card dispute in the Market: the seller, as a negative balance recovered from future payouts, or the protection reserve when the seller kept every rule, on the kit's loss rules.

features.name: Protection pool
features.does: Know buyers are refunded even when a seller cannot pay back, from a small pool shown on the cost ledger.

parts.name: Market protection pool
parts.what: What the Market's protection pool covers and its limits, on the kit's protection pool.

features.name: Know who the seller is
features.does: Know who sold you the item, who charges sales tax on it, and who answers for it if something goes wrong.

parts.name: Market seller of record
parts.what: The Market's choice on the kit's seller of record: the trader is the seller, except where the Market is the deemed supplier, for low-value imported goods and its own buyer fee. This sets who charges sales tax, who owes consumer guarantee duties (example: under New Zealand's Consumer Guarantees Act), whose name is on the receipt and who answers card disputes.

features.name: Pay safely for a car or other big item
features.does: Pay for a car, boat or machinery by low-cost bank payment into a held account, or by a deposit then the balance.

parts.name: Held bank payment for big items
parts.what: Pays a high-value order by bank payment into a held account, where card costs would be too high, and releases it on the same rules as other orders.

parts.name: Deposit then balance
parts.what: A deposit held when the deal is agreed and the balance paid at handover, for items such as vehicles and machinery.

areas.name: Shipping, pickup and delivery
areas.summary: Getting the item from seller to buyer: shipping prices, courier labels, tracking, safe pickups with a handover code, local delivery, overseas shipping and return labels.

features.name: Choose how it gets there
features.does: Offer pickup, or set shipping prices for each part of the country.

parts.name: Shipping profiles
parts.what: Reusable sets of shipping options and prices per seller, attached to listings.

parts.name: Delivery estimates
parts.what: Making time plus typical transit time, shown as a date range.

parts.name: Rural and island delivery
parts.what: Rural, island and remote area surcharges handled and shown up front.

parts.name: Shipping cost after the sale
parts.what: When shipping is worked out after a sale, the seller sends the cost and the buyer pays it in the app.

features.name: Pick up safely
features.does: Arrange a pickup time and place, with suggested public meeting spots and a code to confirm the handover.

parts.name: Pickup arranging
parts.what: Propose and agree a time and place in the chat, with reminders.

parts.name: Public meeting spots
parts.what: Suggested well-lit public places that have agreed to be listed, on an open map.

parts.name: No-show handling
parts.what: If a buyer does not turn up, the seller can cancel and relist, and the no-show is recorded.

parts.name: Pickup address shown at the right step
parts.what: Shows the exact pickup address only when an order reaches pickup, through the kit's approximate location, never as free text in the chat; until then buyers see only the suburb or town.

features.name: Track it
features.does: Follow the parcel from the tracking number the seller adds, with dispatch starting the payment release timer.

parts.name: Tracking number entry
parts.what: Seller adds the courier and tracking number when posting by hand, and the buyer gets a tracking link.

features.name: Courier rates, labels and tracking
features.does: Get courier rates by size and weight, buy a label in the app, print it or show a code at a drop-off point, and follow it automatically.

parts.name: Courier research
parts.what: Which couriers have published APIs and terms that allow this.

parts.name: Courier connectors
parts.what: One connector per courier for rates, labels and tracking, built as add-ins so more can be added.

parts.name: Rate calculator
parts.what: Works out courier rates from parcel size, weight and both addresses, at checkout and on the listing form.

parts.name: Tracking updates
parts.what: Pulls tracking events from courier links, tells the buyer, and starts the release timer on delivery.

parts.name: Label printing
parts.what: Labels for thermal printers and plain A4 paper.

parts.name: Label payment
parts.what: Label cost taken from the seller's balance or card, at the courier's price.

parts.name: Courier collection and pickup points
parts.what: Books a courier to collect a parcel from the seller's door, and lets buyers choose delivery to a parcel locker or pickup point, which suits rural buyers.

parts.name: ID-checked delivery
parts.what: A courier service that checks the receiver's ID and age and takes a signature, never leaving the parcel at the door, for alcohol, vapes and other R18 items.

features.name: Packing slips and bulk dispatch
features.does: Print packing slips and labels for many orders at once.

parts.name: Packing slip
parts.what: A packing slip per order with items, options and gift notes.

parts.name: Bulk dispatch screen
parts.what: Select many orders, buy labels, print and mark dispatched in one go.

features.name: Return labels
features.does: Send a prepaid return label when a return is accepted.

parts.name: Return label purchase
parts.what: Buys a return label from the courier and sends it to the buyer, paid by whoever the return policy says.

features.name: Local delivery
features.does: Have a local item delivered the same day by a nearby independent courier.

parts.name: Local delivery as a shared delivery job
parts.what: Offers local Market deliveries to independent couriers on the kit's shared delivery job type, which Spare Food's couriers also carry, with the kit's worker status, health and safety and insurance rules.

parts.name: Large item freight
parts.what: Options for furniture and other large items: freight firms, movers and member helpers.

features.name: Use a fulfilment warehouse
features.does: Send stock to a warehouse that packs and ships orders for the seller.

parts.name: Warehouse connectors
parts.what: Sends orders to a third-party warehouse and brings stock levels and tracking back, built as add-ins.

features.name: Ship overseas
features.does: Sell to buyers in other countries with customs forms filled from the listing.

parts.name: Customs declarations
parts.what: Customs forms filled from item details, value and tariff codes.

parts.name: Duty and tax at checkout
parts.what: Import duty and tax worked out and shown at checkout, so buyers pay no surprise charges on arrival.

parts.name: Country shipping limits
parts.what: Items that may not be sent to, or from, each country.

features.name: Know what can be posted
features.does: See before posting which items couriers refuse or charge more for, such as lithium batteries, aerosols and perfume, and how to send them.

parts.name: Posting dangerous goods
parts.what: What couriers and the postal service in each country allow for lithium batteries, aerosols, perfume, nail polish and other dangerous goods sent within the country, and what they charge extra, starting with New Zealand.

parts.name: Dangerous goods flags
parts.what: Flags listings in categories that carry dangerous goods, shows the courier rules on the listing form, and offers only shipping services that accept them.

areas.name: Orders, returns and after-sale
areas.summary: Everything after the pay button: order lists for both sides, confirming arrival, cancelling, returns under the seller's policy and the law, reporting problems, custom and digital orders.

features.name: See my orders
features.does: See every purchase and sale with its status in one list.

parts.name: Order record
parts.what: The Market's order on the kit's order steps: items, options, prices, fees, shipping, payment and messages.

parts.name: Market order states
parts.what: The Market's states on the kit's order steps (paid, dispatched, delivered, received, problem, disputed, refunded and closed) and the allowed moves between them.

parts.name: Market order lists
parts.what: Bought and sold lists on the kit's orders page, with what needs doing next on each Market order.

features.name: Confirm it arrived
features.does: Confirm the item arrived as described, which pays the seller.

parts.name: Confirm received
parts.what: One tap to confirm, which releases the held payment.

parts.name: Confirm reminders
parts.what: Gentle reminders to confirm, and a notice before automatic release.

features.name: Change or cancel an order
features.does: Change the address or items, or ask to cancel, before dispatch, with an instant refund if the seller agrees.

parts.name: Market cancellation rules
parts.what: Who may cancel a Market order and when, set on the kit's cancellation policies, and how a cancel counts in seller standards.

features.name: Report a problem
features.does: Report non-arrival, damage or not as described, and get guided steps before a dispute.

parts.name: Problem report flow
parts.what: Asks what went wrong, gathers photos, pauses the payment release and tells the seller.

parts.name: Seller response window
parts.what: A set time for the seller to fix it, by refund, replacement or return, before the case moves on.

parts.name: Courier claims
parts.what: Guides the seller through claiming from the courier for a lost or damaged parcel, with the evidence from the order.

features.name: Return an item
features.does: Return an item for a fault, or for a change of mind where the seller allows it.

parts.name: Return policies
parts.what: Seller's change of mind policy, with the consumer law minimum shown for in-trade sellers.

parts.name: Return requests
parts.what: Request, approve, ship back, receive and refund, each step an operation.

parts.name: Your rights guide
parts.what: Explains a buyer's rights in plain words, depending on whether the seller is in trade.

features.name: Follow a custom or digital order
features.does: Follow the making of a custom item, and download digital items.

parts.name: Making updates
parts.what: Seller posts progress and photos on a made-to-order item, linked to the order.

parts.name: Downloads page
parts.what: A buyer's digital purchases with their download links.

features.name: Ship in parts and exchange online
features.does: Send an order in more than one parcel, or swap an item for another size or colour without a refund and a new order.

parts.name: Part and split shipments
parts.what: Ships some items of an order now and the rest later, or from different places, each parcel with its own tracking, and releases the held money for each parcel as it arrives.

parts.name: Online exchanges
parts.what: Swaps a returned item for another size, colour or option, charging or refunding any price difference, with stock moved in one step.

areas.name: Messages and questions
areas.summary: Talking about an item: public questions on listings, private chat linked to the item or order on the kit's chat, warnings on risky messages, notifications people choose and translation, with reporting through the kit.

features.name: Ask a question in public
features.does: Ask the seller a question on the listing, with the answer shown to every buyer.

parts.name: Public questions
parts.what: Questions and answers stored with the listing and shown on its page.

parts.name: Question checks
parts.what: Screens public questions for abuse and contact details before they show.

features.name: Chat with a buyer or seller
features.does: Message privately about an item, with photos and offers in the chat.

parts.name: Market chat threads
parts.what: Private conversations on the kit's chat service, each linked to a listing or order, with the item, price, offers and order status shown at the top.

parts.name: Quick replies
parts.what: One-tap questions and answers such as asking if an item is still available, in the member's language.

features.name: Warnings on risky messages
features.does: Get a clear warning when a message asks to pay off the platform, shares a strange link, or asks for codes.

parts.name: Market scam patterns
parts.what: The Market's own patterns, such as requests to pay off the platform, fake payment links and requests for codes, set as rules on the kit's scam warnings in chat.

parts.name: Contact detail masking
parts.what: Masks phone numbers, emails and street addresses in early messages; contact details are shared once a sale is agreed, and the pickup address only through the pickup step.

features.name: Notifications you choose
features.does: Choose which updates arrive by push, email or text, and set quiet hours.

parts.name: Market notification types
parts.what: Every Market notification listed with a default channel and urgency.

features.name: Translate messages
features.does: Read a message or listing in your own language with one tap.

parts.name: Translate listings and questions
parts.what: Translates listing text and public questions on request through the kit's machine translation, with the original one tap away; chat uses the kit's message translation.

areas.name: Ratings, buyer protection and disputes
areas.summary: Trust between strangers: two-way ratings from real trades only, buyer protection claims, disputes decided by a member panel while money stays held, and seller standards earned from the record.

features.name: Rate each other
features.does: Rate the other side after each trade, with a short comment and a reply.

parts.name: Market trade ratings
parts.what: Ratings on the kit's ratings service tied to a completed Market order, including cash, swap and pickup trades, revealed together so no one rates in revenge.

parts.name: Rating display
parts.what: Score, count and recent comments on profiles and listings, with replies.

features.name: Claim buyer protection
features.does: Claim a refund when an item does not arrive or is not as described.

parts.name: Protection rules
parts.what: What is covered, up to what amount, by when, and what is not, such as cash trades.

parts.name: Claim flow
parts.what: Opens a claim from a problem report once the seller's response window has passed.

features.name: Disputes decided by members
features.does: Take a disagreement to a panel of trained members, with the money held until they decide.

parts.name: Decision to money
parts.what: Turns a panel decision or a settlement on a Market order into a release, a refund or a split of the held money.

parts.name: Evidence pack and outside routes
parts.what: Exports a case's evidence as one pack for a small claims tribunal (example: New Zealand's Disputes Tribunal), and links to report scams to the online safety agency and police (example: Netsafe in New Zealand), alongside the kit's guidance on outside routes.

features.name: Seller standards
features.does: See which sellers dispatch on time and answer quickly, earned from their record, not bought.

parts.name: Performance measures
parts.what: Dispatch time, reply time, cancellations and problem rates per seller.

parts.name: Reliability badges
parts.what: Badges earned from the measures, shown on profiles and used in ranking.

parts.name: Limits for low standards
parts.what: Warnings, then listing limits, for sellers who fall below the published standards.

features.name: Review a product
features.does: Review the product itself, separate from the trade rating, so later buyers of the same item can judge it.

parts.name: Product reviews
parts.what: Reviews of the product itself, separate from the trade rating, from buyers who bought it, with photos through the kit's file uploads, linked to the listing or catalogue record, on the kit's reviews.

parts.name: Review display
parts.what: Product reviews on listing pages and shop pages, with the seller's reply.

features.name: Honest ratings
features.does: Trust that ratings come only from real trades and that bought or swapped ratings are caught.

parts.name: Market fake rating rules
parts.what: Rules for rings of accounts rating each other through fake sales, set on the kit's fake review checks.

areas.name: Safety, scams and banned items
areas.summary: Keeping the Market safe and legal: rules on banned and restricted items, scam detection, reports, fakes and rights owners, product recalls, known illegal images, and safety for in-person trades.

features.name: Know what can be sold
features.does: Know what may not be sold, and what needs a licence or an age check, before listing.

parts.name: Restricted goods law
parts.what: Every law limiting online sales in each country, with sources, starting with New Zealand's: firearms and restricted weapons, fireworks, alcohol, vapes, medicines, food (Food Act registration), live animals and pets, livestock (NAIT transfers), plants and seeds (biosecurity), wildlife, taonga tūturu (Protected Objects Act: registered collectors only), event tickets (resale bans for major events), publications that need classification labels, second-hand electrical goods, recalled goods, goods with compulsory safety standards and stolen goods.

parts.name: Item rules as data
parts.what: Banned, restricted and licence-needed items written as rules linked to categories and keywords, versioned and voted on.

parts.name: Licence and age checks
parts.what: Checks a seller's licence, or a buyer's age, for items that need one, through the kit's age checks and public register checks.

parts.name: Rules pages
parts.what: Plain pages listing what can and cannot be sold and why.

parts.name: Age check at handover
parts.what: Checks age again when an R18 item changes hands, since a check at purchase alone lets parcels reach under-18s at the door: ID shown at pickup, or a courier that checks ID and takes a signature; until that courier service is linked (MKT-A8-F4-P8), R18 items are pickup only.

parts.name: Second-hand dealer prompts
parts.what: Asks members who trade second-hand goods often enough to be presumed dealers (in New Zealand, 6 or more trading days, or over $2,000, in 12 months) for their dealer's licence, and shows it on their listings.

features.name: Stop scams
features.does: Be protected from fake listings, fake payment emails and account takeovers.

parts.name: Market scam rules
parts.what: Signals specific to buying and selling, such as prices far below value, reused photos and a rush to move to another app, set as rules on the kit's fraud signals, which hold risky listings for review.

parts.name: Safe trading guide
parts.what: Short plain advice on spotting scams, shown where people need it.

features.name: Report a listing or member
features.does: Report a listing, member, review or shop page in two taps, with a reason.

parts.name: Report links on everything
parts.what: A report link on every listing, profile, message, review, shop page, blog post and storefront page, using the kit's report forms.

features.name: Known illegal images blocked
features.does: Have known illegal images blocked at upload, wherever in the Market they are uploaded.

parts.name: Every upload checked
parts.what: Sends every Market upload, from listing, review and chat photos to shop page images, blog images and theme files, through the kit's file service and its known-content checks.

features.name: Fakes and rights owners
features.does: Let brand and copyright owners report fakes or copied photos, and let sellers answer.

parts.name: Rights notices on listings and shops
parts.what: A notice link on every listing and shop page, and takedown and restore of Market listings, on the kit's copyright and trade mark notices, acted on promptly as copyright law's rules for hosts require (example: New Zealand's Copyright Act).

features.name: Product recalls
features.does: Have listings of recalled products found and taken down, and buyers told.

parts.name: Recall list link
parts.what: Pulls government product recall lists, starting with New Zealand's; Spare Food needs food recalls too, so the feed should move down into the kit.

parts.name: Recall matching
parts.what: Matches recalls to listings and past orders by product, brand and model.

features.name: Safer in-person trades
features.does: Share a pickup plan with a friend and get safety tips for meeting a stranger.

parts.name: Share my pickup
parts.what: Sends the pickup time, place and listing to a chosen contact through the kit's trusted contact link, and checks in afterwards.

features.name: Account takeover protection
features.does: Have unusual sign-ins and payout changes stopped before money moves.

parts.name: Big change holds
parts.what: Holds big listing changes, such as mass edits or price changes, after a new-device sign-in until confirmed, alongside the kit's payout change guard.

areas.name: Shop websites
areas.summary: Any business can run its own online shop on Spare Market at cost: its own web address and look, pages and blog, a fast and safe storefront found by web search, checkout with buyer protection, its products also in Market search, and a clean way to move out.

features.name: Open a shop
features.does: Turn a seller account into a shop with a name, logo, about page and policies.

parts.name: Shop builder design
parts.what: How a shop is set up and run end to end on the kit, replacing Shopify for a small business. The shop pages should move down into the kit, since Spare Food's direct ordering page needs the same (FOOD-A13-F4-P1).

parts.name: Shop record
parts.what: A shop owning listings, a storefront, settings, staff and policies, on a seller or business account.

parts.name: Shop set-up guide
parts.what: A short guided set-up: name, logo, look, first products, shipping, payouts and policies.

parts.name: Shop page in the Market
parts.what: A shop page inside Spare Market with its products, ratings and about text.

features.name: Choose a look
features.does: Pick a theme, change colours, fonts and layout, and see changes before publishing.

parts.name: Theme format
parts.what: Our own open theme format of templates, blocks and settings, with a published specification.

parts.name: Starter themes
parts.what: A set of themes designed from scratch for different kinds of shop, all accessible and fast.

parts.name: Visual editor
parts.what: Drag blocks, change settings and preview on phone and desktop, with undo and published versions.

parts.name: Theme add-ins
parts.what: Themes and blocks from other designers, run as sandboxed add-ins and kept off checkout pages.

features.name: Use your own web address
features.does: Use your own domain name, with a secure certificate set up automatically and a storefront kept safe from card-skimming scripts.

parts.name: Custom domains
parts.what: Connect a domain, check its records and issue free security certificates automatically; Spare Stay and Spare Social map their own web addresses too (STAY-A21-F3-P2, SOC-A1-F3-P1), so this should move down into the kit as one domain service.

parts.name: Domain buying
parts.what: Whether the co-op can sell domain names at cost through a registrar, and the rules for country domains such as .nz names.

parts.name: Free shop address
parts.what: A free web address for shops without a domain, on a separate domain registered on the Public Suffix List, so no shop can read another shop's or the Market's cookies.

parts.name: Storefront security
parts.what: Serves shop sites apart from the Market's own domain, keeps theme and add-in scripts off checkout pages, and sets content security rules and script checks on every page that leads to payment, as the card industry's rules for payment pages ask.

features.name: Pages, blog and menus
features.does: Add pages, blog posts and menus to tell the shop's story.

parts.name: Pages and blog
parts.what: Pages and blog posts with text, images and product blocks.

parts.name: Menus
parts.what: Header and footer menus edited by drag and drop.

features.name: Fast shop pages found by web search
features.does: Have shop pages that load fast on a phone and show up well in web search.

parts.name: Storefront server
parts.what: Renders shop pages on the server from the theme and listings, cached close to buyers.

parts.name: Shop web search basics
parts.what: Uses the Market's server-rendered listing pages, product data markup and site maps (MKT-A2-F1-P5) for shop pages, with page titles, descriptions and tidy web addresses set per shop.

parts.name: Redirects from old addresses
parts.what: Keeps old product and page links working after a shop moves in, so it keeps its web search ranking.

parts.name: Shop search and filters
parts.what: Search and filters inside a shop's own site.

parts.name: Storefront API
parts.what: A public read-only API of a shop's products, collections, prices and stock, with cart and checkout hand-off, for shops that build their own front end, generated from the Market's command schemas.

features.name: Checkout on the shop's site
features.does: Let customers buy on the shop's own site with buyer protection, including guests, and a payout timing that suits a business.

parts.name: Storefront checkout
parts.what: The Market checkout styled to the shop's theme, on the shop's own address.

parts.name: Shopper accounts
parts.what: Shoppers sign in with a Spareware login or, once the guest checkout decision allows it, check out as guests.

parts.name: Guest checkout decision
parts.what: Whether shop sites take orders from guests with no account, weighing card fraud, anti-money-laundering duties and data rights; owned here until the kit opens one shared decision, since Spare Food waits on the same one (FOOD-A1-F1-P6).

parts.name: Held or normal payouts for shop sales
parts.what: Decides whether sales on a shop's own site use held payments or pay out within days like other shop builders, since a business whose money waits for each delivery loses cash flow; the answer may depend on the shop's record.

parts.name: Disputes for guest buyers
parts.what: Lets a buyer who checked out as a guest open a problem report and a dispute from a link in the receipt, and take part by email without a Spareware login.

features.name: Talk to shoppers
features.does: Answer shoppers' questions from a chat box on the shop's own site, in the same inbox as Market messages.

parts.name: Storefront chat
parts.what: A chat box on the shop's site that feeds the seller's Market inbox.

features.name: Shop products in Market search
features.does: Have the shop's products appear in Spare Market search to reach more buyers.

parts.name: Shared listings
parts.what: One product shown in the shop and in the Market, with one stock count.

features.name: Shop policies and legal pages
features.does: Publish returns, shipping, privacy and terms pages from plain templates that meet the law.

parts.name: Policy templates
parts.what: Our own plain-language policy templates, checked by a lawyer, filled from the shop's settings.

parts.name: Accessibility statement
parts.what: An accessibility statement for each shop as our own choice: the European Accessibility Act exempts microenterprises that provide services (fewer than 10 staff and no more than EUR 2 million turnover or balance sheet), which covers most shops; the statement says who provides the service, the shop for its own site or the Market for the shared checkout.

features.name: Move your shop out
features.does: Take the whole shop to another host in open formats, including its web address.

parts.name: Whole-shop export
parts.what: Exports products and variants, images, pages, blog posts, redirects, discount codes and the theme in the open theme format, plus customers who agreed to it, as open files.

parts.name: Domain move-out
parts.what: Steps to point the shop's domain at a new host, with the old links redirected for a set time.

features.name: Sell in other languages and countries
features.does: Show the shop's own product text, pages and blog in other languages, with prices set per country.

parts.name: Translated shop content
parts.what: The seller's product text, pages and blog posts in several languages, written by the seller or machine-translated through the kit and marked as such.

parts.name: Prices per country
parts.what: Prices set per country, or worked out from one price, with the tax each country's rules ask for.

features.name: Pay for hosting at cost
features.does: See what the shop's site costs to host each month and pay only that.

parts.name: Hosting cost per shop
parts.what: Measures each shop's storefront traffic, domain and storage, prices it at cost from the ledger, and shows the amount before the shop opens.

parts.name: Monthly hosting bill
parts.what: Charges each shop its hosting cost monthly through the kit's regular payments, with a receipt and notice before a site is paused for a failed payment.

features.name: Work with others on a shop
features.does: Let an outside designer or bookkeeper work on the shop, hide the shop behind a password until launch, and see visitor counts without trackers.

parts.name: Outside helpers
parts.what: Time-limited access for an outside designer or bookkeeper to the theme, products or reports only, through the kit's delegated access.

parts.name: Password page before launch
parts.what: Keeps a shop site behind a password page until the owner opens it.

parts.name: Shop visitor counts
parts.what: Visits, top pages and sources for the shop site, counted in totals with no tracking cookies, through the kit's private usage counts.

areas.name: Shop selling tools
areas.summary: The tools a shop runs its business with: products and collections, one stock count across places, discounts, gift cards, customers and newsletters, subscriptions, wholesale, and selling on other channels.

features.name: Products and collections
features.does: Organise products into collections by hand or by rules such as tag, type or price.

parts.name: Collections
parts.what: Manual and rule-based groups of products for menus, pages and sales.

parts.name: Product spreadsheet import and export
parts.what: Add or update products in bulk from an open spreadsheet format.

parts.name: Product tags and types
parts.what: Free tags and product types for organising and filtering.

parts.name: Custom product fields
parts.what: Shop-defined extra fields on products, shown by themes and readable by add-ins.

features.name: One stock count across places

assess: Walk through selling a used item and buying one from a stranger: is every step there, from the first photo to the rating?
Is the core set small enough to build first, yet good enough that a Trade Me or Facebook Marketplace user would switch?
Should money always be held, even for local pickup, or should cash on pickup stay as an uncovered choice?
Should auctions stay at later, given how many buyers in launch countries such as New Zealand expect them?
Is no paid placement in search the right rule, or should members vote on promotion at cost?
Shops: start with Market sellers who want a shop page, or go after small businesses on Shopify with their own web addresses from day one?
Is a till for physical shops worth building ourselves, or should the payment provider's own till be linked instead?
Who sits on dispute panels, how are they chosen and trained, and are they paid?

Which restricted items are never allowed at launch, such as firearms, alcohol and vapes, and which need licence or age checks, given that R18 items stay pickup only until an ID-checked courier service is linked (MKT-A12-F1-P5, MKT-A8-F4-P8)?
Do the anti-money-laundering duties change how held payments, payouts or seller checks must work?
Which town or community should the launch plan target first, and how does the Market beat the local incumbent's network effect there (example: Trade Me in New Zealand)?
Is AI help for writing a listing from photos core or next, and what must the seller always confirm?
Should vehicles be in the first release, given how much of the big marketplaces' traffic they bring (example: Trade Me), or wait until the money owing and dealer rules are built?
Which countries come after New Zealand, and which of their rules (EU, UK, Australia) shape the core now so nothing is rebuilt later?
Do the demo screens look like our own design, with nothing copied from any incumbent's interface?
Who pays the Market's fee, and is it flat or based on value (MKT-A7-F2-P4)? Does it stay fair for a free item, a $2 item and a $30,000 car, now that Trade Me charges sellers 2.19%?

Who is the seller of record (MKT-A7-F9-P1): the trader, except where the Market is the deemed supplier for low-value imported goods and its own buyer fee? Does a lawyer agree, since it sets who charges sales tax, who owes consumer guarantees and who answers card disputes?

Does the Market count as an internet auction provider under New Zealand's Secondhand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2004 from launch, even before auctions, and how does it collect sellers' dates of birth for Police without collecting more than it needs (MKT-A21-F6-P3)?
Should sales on a shop's own site use held payments or pay out within days (MKT-A13-F6-P4), and may shops take guest orders (MKT-A13-F6-P3)?
Hire of items between members, such as tools, cameras and party gear, is mapped here as MKT-A2-F14 (later). Should it stay in the Market or move to Spare Rent?

Pieces: the kit now maps MK01, MK04 and MK05 on its own parts (KIT-A3-F2-P1, KIT-A10-F12-P1 and P2, KIT-A6-F1-P1 and P2), and the Market's copies are gone.
